steps.title: Test the edges
steps.say: Most bugs hide at the smallest inputs. Decide the answer for each before you write the method.

board.code:
isPrime(0)  // false
isPrime(1)  // false: primes start at 2
isPrime(2)  // true
factorial(0) // 1, by definition
reverseString("")  // ""

marks.label: the edge that's easy to miss

steps.title: Checking divisors
steps.say: To test a prime, try every divisor from 2 up to n - 1. One that divides evenly means it isn't prime.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find try your methods
steps.say: `main` is at the bottom of the file. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `try your methods` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find try your methods with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Try them in main
steps.say: `main` starts empty. Call each method with edge cases and print the results.
